# Error catalogue

The long tail. Load this when the six patterns in the skill body do not fit.
Settings paths are what the user sees in the app.

## Provider and model

| Log signal | Cause | Next step |
|---|---|---|
| `status=401`, `invalid_api_key`, `Incorrect API key` | Key wrong, expired, revoked, or belonging to another provider | Settings → Providers → the provider → re-paste the key |
| `status=403` | Key is valid but not entitled to this model or region | Settings → Providers → pick a model the account can use |
| `status=404` on the request path | Base URL missing `/v1`, or the API format does not match the endpoint | Settings → Providers → Base URL, API format |
| `status=400` naming a parameter | The model rejects something that was sent — most often `temperature` on a reasoning model, or a thinking budget it does not accept | Settings → Assistants → clear Temperature, or turn Thinking off |
| `status=400` naming the model | Model id not served by this base URL | Settings → Providers → Model ID |
| `status=429`, `rate_limit_exceeded` | Upstream throttle or quota | Wait, or switch provider |
| `status=500`/`502`/`503` | The provider is failing, not the app | Retry later; nothing to change locally |
| `Stream idle timeout` | The connection stalled for five minutes mid-response | Usually network. If it repeats on one provider only, that provider is stalling |
| `context window`, `maximum context length` | The request exceeded the model's context | Settings → Assistants → Context: turn on Auto compact, lower Context limit, or lower Keep recent |

## Context compaction

| Log signal | Cause | Next step |
|---|---|---|
| No compaction records despite a large context | Auto compact is off, or the conversation has too few messages to compact | Settings → Assistants → Context → enable Auto compact |
| `Auto-compact failed` with a provider error | The summarisation request itself was rejected | Fix whatever the provider row above says; compaction uses the same provider as the chat |
| `Mid-turn compact failed` then a fallback | Compaction failed during a tool loop and the history was trimmed instead | Same as above. The turn survived, but older context was dropped rather than summarised |
| `Not enough messages to compact` | The conversation is shorter than twice the Keep recent setting | Nothing wrong; it will compact once the thread is longer |

## MCP servers

| Log signal | Cause | Next step |
|---|---|---|
| `failed to spawn`, `ENOENT`, `code=127` | The command is not installed or not on PATH | Settings → MCP servers → correct the command, or install it |
| `code=1` right after start | The server started and exited — usually bad arguments or a missing env var | Settings → MCP servers → check args and environment |
| Handshake timeout | The process is running but never spoke the protocol | Check the server's own output; try the command by hand |
| Tools missing after a successful connect | The server exposes none, or they are filtered out | Settings → MCP servers → confirm the server lists tools |

## Tools and permissions

| Log signal | Cause | Next step |
|---|---|---|
| A tool call denied by the user | An `Ask`-permission tool was refused | Name which tool was refused and offer to run it again |
| `Access denied`, `outside the authorized locations` | The path is outside the project, or outside the Android storage grant | Settings → General → File access; on Android grant the folder or enable all-files access |
| `SANDBOX_DENIED` | The sandbox blocked a write or a network call | Settings → General → turn the sandbox off, or approve the retry-without-sandbox prompt |
| `No skill named 'X' is available` | The skill exists on disk but is not bound | Settings → Skills → bind it (global, project or assistant) |
| A model that cannot call tools | The model has no tool support, so the tool set was cleared | Settings → Assistants → choose a tool-capable model |

## Startup and storage

| Log signal | Cause | Next step |
|---|---|---|
| `failed to index skills` | A skill directory is malformed — usually a missing or invalid frontmatter block | Settings → Skills → check recently added skills |
| `failed to write the manual skill` | The skills directory is not writable | Check disk space and permissions on the app data directory |
| `panic:` | A bug in the app | Report it with the surrounding log lines; the backtrace field is in the same record |
| `early log lines were dropped` | Something logged heavily before the log file was open | Not a fault by itself, but the records just after it explain what was noisy |
